user.title: Connect HomeIQ
user.description: HomeIQ needs the MCP server that serves its read-only tools and the AgentForge instance that answers conversations and tasks. Both are checked before the entry is created.

data_description.mcp_url: Base URL only; HomeIQ appends /mcp. The server listens on port 8050.
data_description.agentforge_api_key: The afp_ project key for this HomeIQ project.

reconfigure.title: Update HomeIQ endpoints
reconfigure.description: Change the HomeIQ MCP or AgentForge endpoint. Both are checked before the change is saved.

error.mcp_cannot_connect: Could not reach the HomeIQ MCP server at that URL.
error.mcp_invalid_auth: The HomeIQ MCP server rejected that bearer token.
error.agentforge_cannot_connect: Could not reach AgentForge at that URL.

data_description.agentforge_project: The AgentForge project slug conversations and tasks are invoked against.
data_description.exposed_tools: Leave empty to offer every tool in the HomeIQ catalogue.

structure_not_json.message: AgentForge did not return JSON for a structured task. It replied: {response}

structure_mismatch.message: AgentForge's answer did not match the requested structure: {reason}
